_about: The N-600 cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The address (uscis.gov/n-600 'Where to File', updated 06/01/2026: Phoenix or Elgin by state; schemas/uscis_lockboxes_n600.json) and the fee ($1,385 on paper; none for a service member applying for themself; Form G-1055 10/01/26) come from src/certificate.py. The attorney approves this file before volume use.

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.
N-600: a parent or legal guardian signs Part 8 for a client under 14. Part 12 stays blank. It is signed at the interview.
Enclose the filing fee by the enclosed Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or a Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check: the amount in the cover letter. Not when the letter says no fee is due.
